dispositions.owner: Architect owns design decisions and the sealed architecture handoff.
dispositions.lifecycle: When an orchestrated handoff invokes Architect, Architect owns the architecture stage and its single handoff.
dispositions.workers: Bounded read-only evidence gathering is earned when it improves coverage or context isolation.
dispositions.specialists: Independent design challenge is earned for consequential ambiguity.
dispositions.writes: The Architect owner is the only writer.
dispositions.rationale: Evidence labor and independent design challenge are separable from final design authority.

dispositions.owner: Blueprint owns planning scope, decisions, and the sealed blueprint.md.
dispositions.lifecycle: When another orchestrated handoff invokes Blueprint, Blueprint still owns the planning stage and `blueprint.md`.
dispositions.workers: Bounded read-only repository exploration is earned when it avoids owner context pollution.
dispositions.specialists: Material planning review remains owner-consumed judgment rather than cheapest-worker labor.
dispositions.writes: Blueprint alone writes blueprint.md; exploration is read-only.
dispositions.rationale: Repository evidence gathering can be cheap to verify while planning authority cannot be delegated.

dispositions.owner: Construct owns implementation, conformance, and the completion report.
dispositions.lifecycle: When an orchestrated handoff invokes Construct, it owns the execution stage and the completion report.
dispositions.specialists: One fresh read-only conformance reviewer is earned only for non-trivial, materially risky changes.
dispositions.writes: All implementation writes remain with the Construct owner.
dispositions.rationale: Implementation semantics and writes stay direct; only earned independent conformance review is separable.

dispositions.owner: Ticket owns both fixed effects: preview reconciliation and confirmed publication for persist, plus read-only selection and narrowing for select.
dispositions.lifecycle: An invocation remains the Ticket stage owner; persist and select keep separate effect authority and only plan-ready select output passes to Blueprint.
dispositions.workers: No worker seam is earned around the bounded publication transition or coupled read-only graph selection.
dispositions.specialists: No separate specialist branch is currently earned.
dispositions.writes: Persist publishes only after separate user confirmation; select remains read-only and seals ticket-scope.md.
dispositions.rationale: One public identity is required, while fixed adapters preserve the existing publication and selection authority boundaries.

dispositions.owner: Assess owns assessment depth, accepted findings, and the sealed assessment.md decision result.
dispositions.lifecycle: When another orchestrated handoff invokes Assess, it owns the independent assessment stage and assessment.md; the upstream owner retains merge and implementation authority.
dispositions.workers: Bounded read-only subagents may perform earned semantic falsification slices and return compact candidate findings or bounded-clear scope.
dispositions.specialists: A fresh-context reviewer is earned when the Assess owner wrote or planned the change in its current context; a consequential clear challenge is optional, earned, and limited to at most one fresh bounded adversarial pass; all Assess delegates together never exceed two per invocation.
dispositions.writes: Delegates are read-only; only Assess writes its ignored repository-local .first-four-hours/assessments/<slug>/assessment.md result.
dispositions.rationale: Assess can improve coverage and context economy through bounded candidate discovery, while final finding acceptance and result authority stay owner-owned.

dispositions.owner: Diagnose owns investigation scope, accepted findings, improvement evidence judgment, and the sealed diagnosis.md.
dispositions.lifecycle: When another orchestrated handoff invokes Diagnose, it owns the diagnosis stage and diagnosis.md.
dispositions.workers: Read-only evidence workers may inspect disjoint bounded surfaces or gather bounded measurement evidence.
dispositions.specialists: An earned Reason challenge may test one consequential provisional finding.
dispositions.writes: Workers receive no repository execution, write, publication, or persistence authority.
dispositions.rationale: Evidence collection is separable and cheaply re-verifiable; diagnosis decisions are not.

dispositions.owner: Ideate owns framing, synthesis, conclusions, and the sealed ideation.md.
dispositions.lifecycle: When Blueprint planning or another orchestrated handoff consults Ideate, Ideate owns ideation.md and the caller keeps its own decisions.
dispositions.workers: Bounded research may be delegated when it materially improves evidence breadth or context quality.
dispositions.specialists: An earned Reason challenge may test a consequential claim.
dispositions.writes: Research workers are read-only; Ideate alone writes ideation.md and its receipt.
dispositions.rationale: Research labor can be bounded independently while ideation judgments and synthesis remain owner-owned.

dispositions.owner: Reason owns one temporary reasoning intervention and returns a defensible next move, bounded challenge result, or one question to the invoking owner.
dispositions.lifecycle: Reason restores decision readiness, challenges one consequential claim, or asks one irreducible user-owned question without taking the domain owner's task or artifact authority.
dispositions.workers: Reason may recommend delegation as an owner next move; it does not create a nested worker tree.
dispositions.specialists: One fresh read-only challenger is expected when a challenge targets the consulting agent's own non-trivial proposal or result whose failure would be hard to reverse or cross a safety, security, permission, or authority boundary, unless the owner skill defines its own fresh challenger, reviewer, or adversarial specialist; the owner rechecks its return, and no panel, voting, persona, or recursion is earned.
dispositions.writes: Reason is read-only, temporary, stateless, and artifact-free.
dispositions.rationale: Its bounded reasoning is the semantic task; splitting it into worker or public helper identities would blur blocker, challenge, question, and domain ownership.

dispositions.owner: Router owns the semantic choice of the smallest sufficient route of public capabilities and its sealed route.md.
dispositions.lifecycle: Router seals one route.md and returns control; it never invokes routed capabilities.
dispositions.workers: No worker seam is earned for one bounded route decision.
dispositions.specialists: No specialist branch is currently earned.
dispositions.writes: Router writes only the ignored .first-four-hours/routes/<slug>/route.md handoff and its local Git exclude rule.
dispositions.rationale: Delegation would add overhead to one short route decision.

dispositions.owner: Scribe owns source-grounded authoring or audit judgment and the final controlled document or audit.
dispositions.lifecycle: An invocation remains the documentation-stage owner under its operation and profile authority.
dispositions.workers: No worker seam is earned; source grounding and language decisions are tightly coupled.
dispositions.specialists: No separate specialist branch is currently earned.
dispositions.writes: Only an authorized write operation may modify documentation; audits never modify documents and write only their ignored report.
dispositions.rationale: Deterministic validators already own cheap mechanical checks, leaving no useful agent-worker seam.

dispositions.owner: PR owns the description content, its mechanical check, and the confirmed publication.
dispositions.lifecycle: PR remains the description-and-publication owner when another workflow invokes it.
dispositions.workers: No worker seam is earned; reading the diff and its authority is the semantic task.
dispositions.specialists: No separate specialist branch is currently earned.
dispositions.writes: PR writes only its draft and run log outside the repository and, after explicit confirmation, the GitHub pull request.
dispositions.rationale: The description depends on one coherent reading of the change; splitting it adds coordination without cheap verification.

dispositions.owner: Charter owns the definition conversation and the charter artifact.
dispositions.lifecycle: The invocation remains the Charter stage owner.
dispositions.workers: No bounded worker seam is earned.
dispositions.specialists: No separate specialist branch is currently earned.
dispositions.writes: Charter alone writes the charter and its publication pointer.
dispositions.rationale: The semantic work is the conversation itself, and the user owns the decisions.

dispositions.owner: Tutor owns the teaching, its judgment of the learner's demonstrated understanding, and its lesson records and learning sequence.
dispositions.lifecycle: Tutor remains the teaching owner when another skill or the learner hands it conceptual gaps.
dispositions.workers: No worker seam is earned; teaching adapts turn by turn to one learner's responses.
dispositions.specialists: No separate specialist branch is currently earned.
dispositions.writes: Tutor writes only under .learning/<subject>/ in the invocation folder, and only for continuing learning or an explicit request to keep something.
dispositions.rationale: Adaptive teaching depends on one continuous reading of the learner; splitting it adds coordination without cheap verification.

dispositions.owner: Examiner owns examination research, paper design and audit, marking and diagnosis, its practice sets, and the examination coverage section of the study plan.
dispositions.lifecycle: Examiner remains the examination-practice owner when a student brings an attempt or another skill names an examination goal.
dispositions.workers: No worker seam is earned; paper design, solving, and audit depend on one coherent reading of the examination's requirements.
dispositions.specialists: No separate specialist branch is currently earned.
dispositions.writes: Examiner writes only under .learning/<subject>/ in the invocation folder: practice sets under exams/<exam>/, only its own sections of study-plan.html, and the subject's START_HERE.html.
dispositions.rationale: Fidelity and audit depend on the same requirement reading that wrote the paper; splitting it adds coordination without cheap verification.
